summary: Completed public API and browser testing for landing, navigation, pass selection, manual UPI booking, confirmation, WhatsApp CTA, and mobile layout.
action_items: Implement actual date-based price increases or a countdown; current prices are static despite the urgency copy.
critical_code_review_comments: passTiers contains hard-coded prices and no date-based pricing calculation, so the requested pricing behavior is not implemented.
The design brief mentions booking-interest/group registration and admin review, but App.js and server.py provide no corresponding form, admin view, or protected review workflow.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST-prefixed booking through the public API and one browser test booking; no seeded production data modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Core public booking flow passed. Retest dynamic pricing/countdown and any added interest/admin workflows. Manual UPI is text-reference only; no file upload was present or tested.
rca of the issue: Static pricing is caused by passTiers storing fixed single/couple values and submitBooking posting those values directly; there is no current-date calculation or timer state. Missing interest/admin functionality is structural: no routes, models, or UI components exist for those workflows.
